def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = d["arcs"]
    net_supply = d["net_supply"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.cities = pyo.Set(initialize=cities)
    model.arcs = pyo.Set(initialize=list(arcs.keys()), dimen=2)

    # Variables: shipment on each arc, bounded by capacity, non-negative
    def x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, arcs[(i, j)][1])

    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.arcs,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=x_bounds,
    )

    # Objective: minimise total transportation cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(arcs[(i, j)][0] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Flow balance: outflow - inflow = net_supply  (for each city)
    def balance_rule(m, k):
        out_flow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        in_flow = sum(m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return out_flow - in_flow == net_supply[k]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.cities, rule=balance_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    n = d["n_cities"]
    routes = d["routes"]
    net_supply = d["net_supply"]

    # Sets
    model.C = pyo.RangeSet(0, n - 1)
    model.R = pyo.Set(dimen=2, initialize=list(routes.keys()))
    # out-neighbors of each city
    model.out_arcs = pyo.Set(model.C, initialize={
        i: [j for (a, j) in routes if a == i] for i in model.C
    })
    # in-neighbors of each city
    model.in_arcs = pyo.Set(model.C, initialize={
        j: [i for (i, b) in routes if b == j] for j in model.C
    })

    # Variables: shipment on each route, bounded by capacity, non-negative
    def x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, routes[(i, j)]["cap"])

    model.x = pyo.Var(model.R, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=x_bounds)

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(routes[(i, j)]["cost"] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in m.R)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Flow balance: inflow - outflow = -net_supply  (net_supply>0 => surplus => out>in)
    def balance_rule(m, k):
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for i in m.in_arcs[k])
        outflow = sum(m.x[k, j] for j in m.out_arcs[k])
        return inflow - outflow == -net_supply[k]

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.C, rule=balance_rule)

    return model

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    cities = d["cities"]
    arcs = list(d["cost"].keys())

    model.N = pyo.Set(initialize=cities)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=arcs, dimen=2)

    # Decision variables: units shipped on each arc (NonNegativeReals, upper bounded)
    def x_bounds(m, i, j):
        return (0, d["capacity"][(i, j)])

    model.x = pyo.Var(
        model.A,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=x_bounds,
    )

    # Objective: minimize total transportation cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(d["cost"][(i, j)] * m.x[i, j] for (i, j) in arcs)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Capacity constraints (written explicitly, one per arc)
    def cap_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.x[i, j] <= d["capacity"][(i, j)]

    model.capacity_con = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=cap_rule)

    # Flow balance: outflow - inflow = balance (supply positive / demand negative)
    def balance_rule(m, k):
        outflow = sum(m.x[k, j] for (i, j) in arcs if i == k)
        inflow = sum(m.x[i, k] for (i, j) in arcs if j == k)
        return outflow - inflow == d["balance"][k]

    model.flow_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.N, rule=balance_rule)

    return model
